Orchestrator overrides: (1) no WebSearch at plan time - planned from files only; (2) working set = ENTIRE science pool (4 core + 50 rotation keywords), no date rotation; (3) up to ~40 queries, highest-yield first. Queries are scoped to the science category's allowed_domains in sources.json. Relevance test from sources.json applies: keep only items where AI actually advances or intersects scientific research/method; drop pure AI-industry noise (funding, compute, hiring).
